record.t: Has served as Iowa Attorney General since January 3, 2023.

record.t: Was elected Iowa Attorney General in November 2022, the first Republican to hold the office since 1979.

record.t: Became the Guthrie County Attorney in Iowa (2018).

record.t: Served as Fremont County Attorney and then, from 2018, as Guthrie County Attorney before becoming Attorney General.
